text: {"claims": [{"id": "c1", "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "max-age response directive"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P0.S0 makes max-age an explicit expiration time; P1.S0 forbids heuristic freshness when an explicit expiration time is present. Together they entail the claim."}, {"id": "c2", "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P7.S0 states s-maxage sets, for a shared cache, the maximum age overriding max-age/Expires; 60 seconds is that maximum age, i.e. freshness lifetime."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P8.S1 states exactly that a shared cache recipient MUST ignore Expires when s-maxage is present."}, {"id": "c4", "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P3.S1 states that unless max-stale is present, the client does not wish to receive a stale response; the claim restates this."}, {"id": "c5", "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P6.S0 imposes the stale-reuse bar on shared caches, and P6.S1 says proxy-revalidate does not apply to private caches."}, {"id": "c6", "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P6.S1 limits proxy-revalidate to non-private caches, so a private cache is not bound by the shared-cache revalidation requirement in P6.S0."}, {"id": "c7", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "In all circumstances, a cache MUST NOT ignore the must-revalidate directive"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S1 requires every cache, in all circumstances, not to ignore must-revalidate."}, {"id": "c9", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P4.S1 states a client giving a max-stale value accepts staleness of no more than that number of seconds; 30 seconds matches the claim."}, {"id": "c10", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "45", "op": ">", "value": "30"}, "reasoning": "P4.S1 caps acceptance at no more than 30 seconds exceeded; 45 exceeds 30, so such a response is not accepted."}]}
